name: Steamed rice rolls
summary: Bánh ướt is steamed rice rolls with a yellow, glossy, sweet fish sauce, plus braised pork, pork loaf, fried pork cake, and fermented pork. The sauce is what defines the plate.
origin: Town, on the provincial tourism site’s 9 June 2021 article.
taste: The site calls the fish sauce yellow, glossy, sweet, and aromatic. That description is that plate’s sauce.
howToEat: Take the rolls with the sauce, and add thịt ram, chả lụa, fried pork cake, or nem chua. The article does not give a wrapper recipe.
seoTitle: Banh uot in Ben Tre — sweet yellow fish sauce
seoDescription: Bánh ướt is steamed rice rolls with a yellow, glossy, sweet fish sauce, plus braised pork and pork loaf.
